---
title: "Poisson_sensitivity"
output: html_document
---

```{r}

bas_rresp <- readRDS("Data/bas.Rds") 

baseline_bas <- lapply(bas_rresp, function(df) df[df$eventname == "baseline_year_1_arm_1", ])

```


# Resilience model

```{r}
model <- function(df) {
  glm(rew_resp_modified ~ race_ethnicity + sex + ps_behav + pos_school_env ,
      family = poisson, data = df)
}

mod <- lapply(baseline_bas, model)
pooled <- mod %>% as.mira() %>% pool()
results_tidy <- broom.mixed::tidy(pooled, conf.int = TRUE)
table_res <- results_tidy %>% select(term, estimate, std.error, p.value, conf.low, conf.high)
```

# Adversity model

```{r}
model <- function(df) {
  glm(rew_resp_modified ~ race_ethnicity + sex + cg_psych + ses_dis_nsafety + primary_cg_lack_supp
                + second_cg_lack_supp + yp_family_conflict + cg_sub_use_bio_sep + family_anger_arg + family_aggression
                + trauma_exposure + lack_supervision,
      family = poisson, data = df)
}

mod <- lapply(baseline_bas, model)
pooled <- mod %>% as.mira() %>% pool()
results_tidy <- broom.mixed::tidy(pooled, conf.int = TRUE)
table_adv <- results_tidy %>% select(term, estimate, std.error, p.value, conf.low, conf.high)
```
